cards.name: Dreo 1500W PTC Ceramic Space Heater (oscillating, with thermostat and remote)
cards.badge: Home comfort · the cheap zone heater
cards.buy_if: You want to heat one small or medium room, a desk or a bathroom-side corner for a few hours, with a thermostat, a timer and a remote, for about the price of a pizza night.
cards.skip_if: You need to heat an open-plan space or run it all night in a drafty room: a 1500W unit tops out near 150 to 200 square feet. For quiet and no remote, the Vornado VH200 (about $60–$70 at Home Depot and Macy's, spring 2026); for a whole-house answer, a heat pump or a furnace tune-up.
cards.owners: Dreo.com's Trustpilot page, read Oct 15, 2026: heater buyers praise fast warm-up and lower bills; one reviewer lost output after about 5–6 weeks; one 2-star (Jul 17, 2026) was a support problem, not a heating one.
cards.video_title: Dreo Portable Space Heater Full Review
cards.video_why: A full-length walk-through of a Dreo portable heater, so you can see the size, the remote and the controls; it may not be the exact Atom One.

buy.pick: Dreo Atom One, model DR-HSH004: 1500W PTC ceramic, 70° oscillation, thermostat 41–95°F, remote, about 10 inches tall
buy.check: The listing names model DR-HSH004 or 'Atom One' and says oscillation plus remote. Dreo sells many look-alike names (316 and 320 do not oscillate; the Tower 718 is a bigger, pricier unit). Sold by Dreo or an 'Official DREO Store'; Dreo says fakes carry no warranty.
